notes: DESIGN-20261102-Q5MU TD-2. First harvest ever run for docs/Engineering Guide/Documentation/01 Principles.md: the live project copy (203 lines) and its canonical template (178 lines) had drifted independently with no prior reconciliation. Inspected both files in full, line by line. Harvested into canonical: (1) the Why section's AI-instruction-budget rationale paragraph, generalizing its literal 'CLAUDE.md' reference to canonical's existing {{ROOT_INSTRUCTIONS}} placeholder; (2) the full 'Wiring Principle' section (progressive-disclosure navigation model and its rules), omitting the live file's two embedded /images/engineering-guide/*.png references as project-specific assets; (3) one sentence appended to 'Operational graph frontmatter' on quoting purpose: values containing YAML-reserved characters. Deliberately left unharvested as local-only customizations: the live file's concrete frontmatter block (id/purpose/keywords -- id is assigned per-project by docs/.og/, not portable template content), both embedded images, and the live file's older 'Diagram and format standards' wording and minor Documentation-destination SoC-test phrasing -- canonical's current wording for those is already a later, more nuanced revision (Applicability-scoped diagram requirement, Default palette tokens, sequence-diagram styling), so harvesting live's older text would regress canonical. Separately corrected in the live file only, independent of this harvest: two long-standing duplication bugs (a stale duplicate 'Certainty principle' bullet and a stale duplicate 'How - doc-type cheat sheet' table), both present since at least commit 09acb50, predating this ticket. The live file itself was otherwise left untouched per instructions -- it is the source observed, not a deployment target, so this operation records no permanent-file write; providers names the provider whose installed canonical-template-derived tree was the observation source for this harvest.
